text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spectators said that Daiichi Ruby's 
popularity had declined ever since she 
focused on sprints. Watching Daiichi Ruby 
listen in silence—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't that kinda boring? We gotta ditch 
this!" Daitaku Helios said, forcibly 
dragging her away. However, Daiichi Ruby 
refused her offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two live in completely different 
worlds. For one, the "clan" is everything— 
and having fun is completely unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Such thoughts made zero sense to Daitaku 
Helios. It's mega hype, so let's just 
party! And with that, she thoroughly 
enjoyed the Spring Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival.
